negative_findings.description: Searched in Ukrainian for a DGF dataset presence on Ukraine's national open-data portal (data.gov.ua) covering banks in liquidation, payouts or asset sales. No DGF dataset page was surfaced by search; all results pointed back to fg.gov.ua HTML pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Could not confirm any machine-readable DGF dataset on data.gov.ua. Not a verdict that none exists — search recall was the limit, and the portal was not queried directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no structured open-data feed exists, all DGF collection must be HTML scraping of article-style pages plus PDF parsing, which is fragile and raises the cost of the collection layer. Worth a direct check of data.gov.ua's own search before committing to a scraper-only design.

negative_findings.description: Two Prozorro.Sale pages (the bankrupt-bank asset-sales landing page and the open-data page) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on plain fetch, while the same URLs appear as normal indexed results in search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as bot-defended-but-presumed-live rather than dead. The specific open-data/API endpoint list for the ЦБД1 bankrupt-bank asset stream could therefore not be enumerated in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prozorro.Sale holds the lot-level auction outcomes that the DGF site only aggregates. Without confirming the API surface, the collection plan for asset-sale pricing remains unspecified. A browser-based or properly-headered fetch should be retried before any liveness verdict.

negative_findings.description: The DGF annual-report landing pages were identified (article URLs per year), but the direct file URLs of the attached PDF/XLS annual report and audited financial statements were not individually enumerated in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Year-level article URLs captured for 2021-2025; per-file attachment URLs unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection pipeline needs the attachment URL pattern (likely under /storage/files/) to fetch the actual financial statements rather than the wrapper page. A single fetch of one report article will resolve this.

negative_findings.description: IADI's respondent-level annual survey data — which would contain Ukraine's own answers on resolution powers, funding and coverage — is members-only; only summary findings are public.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public summaries usable; granular Ukraine record requires a membership or a research-access request.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Peer benchmarking of the Ukrainian failed-bank regime will be coarse unless access is requested. This is an access-negotiation item, not a discovery failure.

negative_findings.description: No established Ukrainian-language term was found for a consolidated, cross-bank 'failed bank financial condition' dataset analogous to the US FDIC's failed-bank list with financials. The DGF's own vocabulary decomposes into per-process terms ('ліквідаційна маса', 'надходження', 'задоволення вимог кредиторів') rather than one dataset name.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched with several constructed Ukrainian phrasings; only the per-process pages surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this cell must target the process vocabulary, not a dataset name. Analysts expecting an FDIC-style single table will need to assemble it from the per-bank subdomains and the receipts/statistics articles.

coverage_gaps.description: The full list of per-bank *.fg.gov.ua liquidation subdomain slugs was not enumerated; only five instances (ukrinbank, bnk, concord, ibox, plus the /banki-shcho-likviduyutsya path-based entries) were observed, and the register page is paginated with a JS 'load more' control.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated crawl of https://www.fg.gov.ua/banki-v-upravlinni-fondu/banki-shcho-likviduyutsya and the three sibling registers, with pagination handled, to produce the authoritative slug/subdomain list. Note that both path-based (/banki-shcho-likviduyutsya/<slug>) and subdomain-based (<slug>.fg.gov.ua) addressing appear to exist and should be reconciled.

coverage_gaps.description: Prozorro.Sale's open-data/API endpoints for the ЦБД1 bankrupt-bank asset stream could not be documented because both relevant pages returned 403 on fetch.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retry via a browser-based fetch or with realistic headers; consult the Prozorro.Sale developer documentation and the ФГВФО organiser profile at https://prozorro.sale/organizers/fgvfo/ to confirm whether lot-level data is exposed as a public API.

coverage_gaps.description: Court-registry coverage of liquidation and resolution disputes was not searched. Shareholders of several resolved banks litigate their market withdrawal for years (the DGF publishes rebuttals on this), and the Єдиний державний реєстр судових рішень would carry those rulings.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a scouting pass on reyestr.court.gov.ua (and the DGF's own litigation section) for case law naming the Fund as liquidator, keyed on 'виведення з ринку', 'ліквідація банку', 'ФГВФО'.

coverage_gaps.description: Alternative electronic auction platforms besides Prozorro.Sale — notably СЕТАМ and the individual accredited electronic trading platforms named in DGF auction passports (e.g. TOV 'NVP Informatsiyni Tekhnolohii') — were identified only in passing and not scouted as sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the accredited-platform list referenced in DGF auction passports and assess whether any publishes results not mirrored on Prozorro.Sale.

coverage_gaps.description: DGF social/messaging channels (Telegram, Facebook, YouTube) under /novini-ta-media were not enumerated. In Ukraine these are often the fastest publication channel for resolution announcements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.fg.gov.ua/novini-ta-media to capture official social handles and assess them as low-latency event feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: The English-language DGF site was mapped, but it was not established how far behind the Ukrainian site it runs, nor whether annual reports are published in English at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Compare the /en statistics and reports pages against their Ukrainian counterparts on as-of dates; if no English annual report exists, record it as an EN negative finding and plan for machine translation of the Ukrainian PDFs.

coverage_gaps.description: Depth of the DGF press-release archive was observed to at least page 30 but the earliest available date and whether the pre-2015 site (old fg.gov.ua URL scheme, e.g. /dlia-vkladnykiv/91-news-uk/...) is still reachable were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the oldest pagination pages and a sample legacy-scheme URL to determine the true archive floor and whether a web-archive backfill is required for the 2014-2016 failure wave.

brief: The Deposit Guarantee Fund (Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб, ФГВФО) runs an unusually rich and well-structured disclosure estate on fg.gov.ua, anchored by a statutory annual activity report with audited financial statements, a live statistics dashboard, four entity registers separating banks in liquidation, liquidated, sold to investors and sold to the state, and — most valuable — a per-bank portal template replicated across every failed institution (both as path-based pages and as dedicated *.fg.gov.ua subdomains) carrying financial information, Fund decisions, creditor-claim registers, payout notices and asset listings that have no equivalent for healthy banks. Around this core sit three complementary layers: the upstream NBU insolvency and licence-revocation decisions that trigger every DGF process, the Prozorro.Sale ЦБД1 auction system that holds lot-level pricing for insolvent-bank assets, and independent scrutiny from the Accounting Chamber (Рахункова палата), whose audits quantify recovery shortfalls the Fund does not self-report. The main collection risks are structural rather than availability-based: no machine-readable open-data feed was confirmed, so the pipeline will depend on HTML and PDF parsing; the per-bank entity list is paginated behind a load-more control and must be enumerated deliberately; and Prozorro.Sale refused plain fetches with HTTP 403, leaving its API surface unverified and presumed bot-defended rather than dead. Local-language coverage is strong — the operative vocabulary is process-based (виведення з ринку, ліквідаційна маса, надходження, задоволення вимог кредиторів, відкриті конкурси з врегулювання) rather than dataset-named, so query design must follow the process terms, and the English mirror should be treated as a secondary cross-check only.
